description: This file is an HTML document that sets up the CodeMirror editor with LESS mode, including relevant scripts, styles, and sample LESS code. It serves as a webpage demonstrating and configuring the LESS syntax highlighting mode in CodeMirror.

methods.name: CodeMirror.fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes a CodeMirror editor instance from a <textarea> element, setting options such as lineNumbers, matchBrackets, and mode to enable LESS syntax highlighting.
